question_text: Identify two differences between an ordinary stack and an ordinary queue.
adaptation_rationale: Fundamental stack queue operations explicit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Stack removes most recent item; queue removes earliest item.Stack push/pop at top; queue enqueues at rear and dequeues at front.
